Privacy Notice - Nimbus Learning Private Limited

Nimbus Learning provides online tutoring for school students. This notice explains how we use personal data.

What we collect and why
We collect the name, email address, class and learning progress of each learner to provide lessons, track progress and communicate with parents. We ask for consent before sending marketing messages.

Retention
The table below shows how long we keep each type of data.
Category | Retention period
Account profile data | Life of the account plus three years
Lesson recordings | Ninety days
Payment and invoice records | Eight years
Customer support chats | Twelve months
Marketing preferences | Until you withdraw consent
After these periods the data is erased or anonymised.

Contact
Questions about this notice can be sent to privacy@nimbuslearning.example.
